contents.title: Dandadan
contents.intro: Dandadan은 고등학생 모모와 그녀의 동급생 오카룬의 이야기를 다룬 애니메이션으로, 장르는 액션, 코미디, 드라마, 로맨스, 공상과학, 초자연적 요소를 포함하고 있다. 이 작품은 2024년 가을에 Science SARU에서 제작되었으며, 현재 평점은 84/100이다. 모모는 영매가 있는 가정에서 성장했으며, 오카룬은 오컬트에 대한 열정을 지닌 캐릭터로, 두 사람의 이야기가 어떻게 전개될지 기대를 모은다.

metadata.description:
This is a story about Momo, a high school girl who comes from a family of spirit mediums, and her classmate Okarun, an occult fanatic. After Momo rescues Okarun from being bullied, they begin talking. However, an argument ensues between them since Momo believes in ghosts but denies aliens exist, and Okarun believes in aliens but denies ghosts exist.

To prove to each other what they believe in is real, Momo goes to an abandoned hospital where a UFO has been spotted and Okarun goes to a tunnel rumored to be haunted. To their surprise, they each encounter overwhelming paranormal activities that transcend comprehension. Amid these predicaments, Momo awakens her hidden power and Okarun gains the power of a curse to overcome these new dangers! Their fateful love begins as well!?

The story of the occult battle and adolescence starts!
(Source: Crunchyroll) 

Notes: 
- Worldwide premiere of Episode 1 before the Japanese television premiere occurred at Anime Expo July 6, 2024. 
- Episodes 1-3 titled as DAN DA DAN: FIRST ENCOUNTER was pre-screened in advance in theaters on August 31, 2024 in Asia, September 7, 2024 in Europe and September 13, 2024 in North America. The regular TV broadcast began October 4, 2024.

contents.title: Mato Seihei no Slave 2
contents.intro: 'Mato Seihei no Slave 2'는 액션, 어드벤처, 드라마, 에치, 판타지, 로맨스 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정입니다. 이 작품은 Passione와 Hayabusa Film이 제작하며, 두 번째 시즌을 통해 계속되는 이야기를 다룹니다. 현재 평점은 72/100입니다.

metadata.description: The second season of Mato Seihei no Slave.

contents.title: Darwin Jihen
contents.intro: 애니메이션 "Darwin Jihen"은 BELLNOX FILMS에서 제작한 Sci-Fi 스릴러로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영됩니다. 주인공 Charlie는 생물학 실험실에서 만들어진 반인반유인원 하이브리드로, 15세가 되어 고등학교 생활을 시작하며 겪는 이야기를 다룹니다. 현재 평점은 64/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Created in a biological science lab, Charlie is a half human, half chimpanzee hybrid known as a "Humanzee". Raised by his adoptive human parents, Charlie is now 15 and starting high school. There he meets Lucy, a clever loner who becomes his first-ever friend. But his “normal” life is shattered when the animal rights extremists who freed his mother from the lab fifteen years ago reemerge as terrorists bent on kidnapping Charlie at all costs.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

contents.title: Dead Account
contents.intro: 'Dead Account'는 SynergySP에서 제작한 액션과 초자연적 요소가 결합된 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영됩니다. 이 작품은 온라인 스트리머 Aoringo가 극단적인 콘텐츠를 제작하며 벌어지는 사건들을 다룹니다. 현재 평점은 61/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Always ready for a fight! Destruction for destruction’s sake! The online streamer Aoringo is a troll, making the worst of the worst of boundary-pushing flamebait content and raking in the revenue from the hate-watchers. You may think he’s nothing more than a bottom feeder and a drain on society, but in reality, he’s high school dropout Souji Enishiro, a caring older brother with a sweet tooth who loves nothing more than his little sister. His viral videos? Just a way to pay his sister’s medical bills. And even if all of humanity hates him, he doesn’t care, so long as his little sister gets better. But then, something very strange begins to happen...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Chainsaw Man: Reze-hen
contents.title_native: チェンソーマン レゼ篇
contents.intro: 애니메이션 "Chainsaw Man: Reze-hen"은 2025년 여름에 방영될 예정이며, MAPPA에서 제작합니다. 이 작품은 액션, 드라마, 호러, 로맨스, 초자연적 요소가 결합된 장르로, 악마의 심장을 가진 소년 덴지가 특수 부서 4의 악마 사냥꾼으로 활동하는 이야기를 다룹니다. 평점은 90점으로, "Chainsaw Man"의 극장판 후속작입니다.

metadata.description:
Theatrical follow-up to Chainsaw Man.
Denji became “Chainsaw Man”, a boy with a devil’s heart, and is now part of Special Division 4’s devil hunters. After a date with Makima, the woman of his dreams, Denji takes shelter from the rain. There he meets Reze, a girl who works in a café.

(Source: MAPPA CHANNEL)

contents.title: Dandadan 2nd Season
contents.intro: 2025년 여름, 'Dandadan 2nd Season'이 Science SARU에서 제작됩니다. 액션, 코미디, 드라마, 로맨스, SF, 초자연적 요소가 결합된 이 작품은 진 '지지' 엔조우지의 집에서 진행 중인 퇴치 미션과 관련된 사건들을 다룹니다. 평점 84/100을 기록하며, 모모 아야세가 납치 미수를 간신히 피하는 등 긴장감 넘치는 전개가 이어질 예정입니다.

metadata.description:
While the mission to exorcise Jin "Jiji" Enjouji's family home is underway, things are not going as expected. Momo Ayase narrowly evades an attempted abduction while Ken "Okarun" Takakura and Jiji are ambushed by the Kitou family—the unsettling landlords of the cursed estate. The trio's efforts threaten the foundation of this enigmatic town shrouded in legends and mysteries.

As Momo, Okarun, and Jiji are drawn deeper into the maze of folklore and supernatural entities, they must each utilize their unique powers if they want to survive and unravel the secrets of the uncanny town.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: Worldwide premiere of Episodes 1-3 titled as DAN DA DAN: EVIL EYE before the Japanese premiere was pre-screened in advance in theaters on June 6, 2025 in North America by GKIDS Films and June 7 and 8 in Europe by Piece of Magic Entertainment and Animation Digital Network.

contents.title: NARUTO: Shippuuden
contents.intro: NARUTO: Shippuuden은 원작 애니메이션 시리즈인 Naruto의 후속작으로, 2007년 겨울에 방영되었습니다. 이 작품은 성숙해진 우즈마키 나루토가 친구 우치하 사스케를 구하기 위한 여정을 그린 액션, 어드벤처, 드라마 장르의 애니메이션입니다. 제작사는 Studio Pierrot이며, 평점은 82/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Naruto: Shippuuden is the continuation of the original animated TV series Naruto. The story revolves around an older and slightly more matured Uzumaki Naruto and his quest to save his friend Uchiha Sasuke from the grips of the snake-like Shinobi, Orochimaru. After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work, though it will not be easy, as he has amassed a few (more dangerous) enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki. 
(Source: Anime News Network)

contents.title: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei
contents.title_native: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛
contents.intro: "매지컬한 판타지 어드벤처 'お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛'는 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정이며, 제작사는 NAZ입니다. 주인공인 바는 공작가의 넷째 아들로 환생한 후 아역 천재로 성장하며, 그의 제작 마법을 활용한 다양한 이야기가 펼쳐집니다. 현재 평점은 66/100입니다."

metadata.description:
Van, fourth son of a marquis, is just a toddler when he realizes he’s been reincarnated. Thanks to his literal lifetime of knowledge, he’s raised as a child prodigy—until his production magic manifests, and it’s the last thing his snooty mage family wants to see! His disappointed father banishes him to a podunk town on the verge of collapse, yet Van can only see the place’s potential. Can our hero’s bastion of battlements build a better life than battle magic ever could?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
contents.intro: 애니메이션 "Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu."는 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영될 예정이며, 액션, 드라마, 미스터리, 스릴러 장르를 포함합니다. 제작사는 Studio DEEN이며, 주인공 유키는 17세의 전문 생존 게임 플레이어로, 계산을 통해 생존을 이어가고 실패가 치명적인 게임 세계의 현실을 다룹니다. 이 작품은 현재 76/100의 평점을 기록하고 있습니다.

metadata.description:
At just seventeen, Yuki is a professional death game player. She’s survived enough rounds to know that survival is calculation, not luck—and that failure is final. For most players, the games are a nightmare with no escape. For Yuki, they’re simply business. Yet in a world where rooms turn into graves and every choice could be her last, even experience offers no protection.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~47 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

contents.title: Shingeki no Kyojin
contents.intro: "‘진격의 거인’은 2013년 봄에 방영된 액션, 드라마, 판타지, 미스터리 장르의 애니메이션으로, WIT STUDIO가 제작하였습니다. 이 작품은 수세기 전, 거인에 의해 거의 멸종된 인류의 생존을 위한 싸움을 그리며, 인간이 처한 극한의 상황과 그로 인해 발생하는 갈등을 탐구합니다."

metadata.description:
Several hundred years ago, humans were nearly exterminated by titans. Titans are typically several stories tall, seem to have no intelligence, devour human beings and, worst of all, seem to do it for the pleasure rather than as a food source. A small percentage of humanity survived by walling themselves in a city protected by extremely high walls, even taller than the biggest of titans.
Flash forward to the present and the city has not seen a titan in over 100 years. Teenage boy Eren and his foster sister Mikasa witness something horrific as the city walls are destroyed by a colossal titan that appears out of thin air. As the smaller titans flood the city, the two kids watch in horror as their mother is eaten alive. Eren vows that he will murder every single titan and take revenge for all of mankind.
(Source: MangaHelpers)

contents.title: Jigokuraku
contents.intro: 'Jigokuraku'(地獄楽)는 2023년 봄 시즌에 방영된 액션, 모험, 미스터리, 초자연적인 요소를 지닌 애니메이션으로, MAPPA가 제작하였다. 이야기의 배경은 에도 시대 말기로, 주인공 가비마루는 사형수 신분에서 벗어나기 위해 미지의 섬에서 특별한 임무를 수행해야 한다.

metadata.description:
The Edo period is nearing its end. Gabimaru, a shinobi formerly known as the strongest in Iwagakure who is now a death row convict, is told that he will be acquitted and set free if he can bring back the Elixir of Life from an island that is rumored to be the Buddhist pure land Sukhavati. In hopes of reuniting with his beloved wife, Gabimaru heads to the island along with the executioner Yamada Asaemon Sagiri. Upon arriving there, they encounter other death row convicts in search of the Elixir of Life... as well as a host of unknown creatures, eerie manmade statues, and the hermits who rule the island. Can Gabimaru find the Elixir of Life on this mysterious island and make it back home alive?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Gnosia
contents.intro: 드라마, 미스터리, 사이언스 픽션, 스릴러 장르의 애니메이션 'Gnosia'(그노시아)는 우주를 떠돌고 있는 우주선에서 벌어지는 이야기입니다. Gnosia라는 적이 인간으로 위장하여 승무원들을 공격하는 상황 속에서, 모두가 서로를 의심하게 되는 긴장감 넘치는 스토리를 담고 있습니다. 이 작품은 domerica에서 제작되었으며, FALL 2025에 방영됩니다.

metadata.description:
The story of GNOSIA takes place on a ship drifting through space. Gnosia is an enemy that disguises itself as a human and attacks them. It is now on the spaceship, causing everyone onboard to be suspicious of each other. The crew decides to vote on the most suspicious-looking person every day and put them into a cold sleep.

If the humans succeed in putting Gnosia to sleep, they'll win. On the other hand, if they don't, everyone on board is in danger. The right decision must be made. No matter what decision is made by the main character, Yuri, she finds herself in a time loop that returns her to the first day of the crisis. 

Will the crew on board make the right decision? What is the secret behind the time loop? What secrets hide behind the faces of everyone on board?

GNOSIA begins now – a story of looping, fleeting moments that feels like an eternity but passes by in an instant.

Have a pleasant journey.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Mayonaka Heart Tune
contents.title_native: 真夜中ハートチューン
contents.intro: "애니메이션 'Mayonaka Heart Tune'은 Gekkou에서 제작한 코미디, 로맨스 장르의 작품으로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영됩니다. 주인공 아리수 야마부키는 밤에 라디오 DJ '아폴로'의 목소리로 위안을 찾았으나, 어느 날 갑자기 방송이 중단되는 이야기를 담고 있습니다."

metadata.description:
When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

(Source: K Manga)

contents.title: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
contents.intro: 'Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku'는 2025년 여름 방영 예정인 코미디, 드라마, 로맨스 장르의 애니메이션입니다. CloverWorks가 제작하며, 남학교인 치도리 고등학교와 인근의 부유한 여학생들이 다니는 기쿄 여자 고등학교 사이의 이야기를 다룹니다. 현재 평점은 85/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Chidori High is a boys’ school that takes in the dregs of society with the lowest grades. Next door stands Kikyo Girls’ High, where the wealthy, high-class families send their precious daughters. Chidori second-year Rintarou, who has a fierce face but a gentle heart, is helping at his family’s patisserie when he meets a girl named Kaoruko. The two hit it off right away…but this blissful peace is quickly disturbed when Rintarou discovers that Kaoruko is actually a student at Kikyo. Worse, she doesn’t seem to realize what a huge problem this really is! Will these two be able to forge a path for themselves, and sidestep the traps (metaphorical and literal) laid by their classmates?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

contents.title: SPY×FAMILY Season 3
contents.intro: "SPY×FAMILY Season 3는 액션, 코미디, 일상, 초자연적 요소가 조화를 이루는 애니메이션으로, 2025년 가을에 방영됩니다. WIT STUDIO와 CloverWorks가 제작하며, 비밀 요원 트와일라이트가 가족 역할을 수행하며 세계 평화를 지키기 위한 어려운 임무를 수행하는 이야기를 다룹니다."

metadata.description:
The third season of SPY×FAMILY. 
World peace is at stake and secret agent Twilight must undergo his most difficult mission yet—pretend to be a family man. Posing as a loving husband and father, he’ll infiltrate an elite school to get close to a high-profile politician. He has the perfect cover, except his wife’s a deadly assassin and neither knows each other’s identity. But someone does, his adopted daughter who’s a telepath!
(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Kaya-chan wa Kowakunai
contents.title_native: カヤちゃんはコワくない
contents.intro: "‘Kaya-chan wa Kowakunai’는 2026년 겨울 방영 예정인 코미디, 호러, 슬라이스 오브 라이프 장르의 애니메이션으로, East Fish Studio에서 제작합니다. 이 작품은 한나무기 유치원에 다니는 카야가 강한 제6감으로 친구들과 가족을 괴롭히는 유령들을 물리치는 이야기입니다."

metadata.description:
Kaya-chan attends Hanamugi Kindergarten, and she has an incredibly strong sixth sense. She secretly beats up the ghosts that stalk her friends and family, but in turn, she’s treated like a troublemaker since nobody understands her strange behavior. Everything changes when her teacher, Chie, discovers her secret. Kaya-chan's fists will go flying at any sinister spirits that show up!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Champignon no Majo
contents.title_native: シャンピニオンの魔女
contents.intro: 'Champignon no Majo'는 Qzil.la와 TYPHOON GRAPHICS가 제작한 드라마 판타지 슈퍼내추럴 장르 작품으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영됩니다. 이야기는 검은 마녀 루나가 독버섯 집에서 조용히 사는 모습을 중심으로 펼쳐지며, 그녀는 도시에서 고효율 약제를 만들고 있지만 '버섯 마녀'가 만지면 어떤 일이 벌어질지에 대한 전설이 전해집니다. 평점은 68/100입니다.

metadata.description: Luna, a black witch who lives quietly in a poisonous mushroom house, deep in the Black Forest. She lives in the city making high-efficiency medicines, but it is said that if the "Mushroom Witch" touches you, you'll die, and she is avoided ... The life of a witch who doesn't know the warmth of people is carefully and momentarily drawn.

contents.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 2nd Season
contents.title_native: 薬屋のひとりごと 第2期
contents.intro: 'Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 2nd Season'은 겨울 2025에 방영될 드라마 및 미스터리 장르의 애니메이션으로, TOHO animation STUDIO와 OLM에서 제작하였습니다. 주인공 마오마오가 제국 궁중의 여러 사건과 음모를 해결하는 과정을 다루며, 평점은 88/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Using her wit and vast knowledge of medicines and poisons alike, Maomao played a pivotal role in solving a series of mysteries and conspiracies that plagued the imperial court. Having recently come to terms with the secrets of her parents, she returns to fulfill her normal duties on behalf of the emperor's highest-ranking consorts. Maomao also works alongside the eunuch Jinshi to better the consorts' many ladies-in-waiting, including helping them learn to read.

However, with the arrival of a merchant caravan comes a new wave of intrigue. A pattern of strange coincidences involving the visitors and their wares unsettles Maomao, driving her to investigate the puzzling circumstances behind the convoy. As dangers from both outside and within threaten the balance between the imperial concubines, Maomao continues to utilize her cunning and medical expertise to keep the women safe from harm.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

contents.title: Black Clover
contents.intro: "블랙 크로버는 마법이 모든 것을 결정하는 세계에서 주인공 아스타와 유노의 이야기를 다룬 액션, 어드벤처, 코미디, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션입니다. 2017년 겨울 시즌에 방영되었으며, 제작사는 Studio Pierrot입니다. 두 인물은 같은 날 교회에서 발견되지만, 유노는 뛰어난 마법 능력을 지닌 반면, 아스타는 마법이 없는 유일한 존재입니다."

metadata.description:
In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: TRIGUN STARGAZE
contents.intro: 애니메이션 "TRIGUN STARGAZE"는 액션, 코미디, 드라마, Sci-Fi 장르의 작품으로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영될 예정이다. 이 시리즈는 "TRIGUN STAMPEDE"의 후속편으로, 잃어버린 JuLai 비극 이후의 혼란스러운 세계를 배경으로 한다. 제작사는 Orange이며, 현재 평점은 72/100이다.

metadata.description:
Sequel season to TRIGUN STAMPEDE.

It’s been two and a half years since the Lost JuLai tragedy, which laid waste to an entire city and engulfed the whole planet in chaos. Meryl, now a senior journalist, continues her search for Vash with her new younger sidekick, Milly, and runs into Wolfwood along the way. As plant robberies begin taking place once again, they sense Millions Knives’s organization conspiring behind the scenes.

Meanwhile, Vash has taken the new name Eriks and is living in hiding in a backwater town when he gets an abrupt visit from Jessica, a young girl with an SOS from the third ship they call home. He thus decides to put an end to a long-standing feud in order to protect those dear to him.

Just as the pieces of the story begin falling back together again, the planet receives a message from the far reaches of outer space: “We are a fleet of colony ships from Earth... Those who wish may accompany us to a new frontier.” The entire population rejoices at this news. However, as if to mock their celebration, the one-winged angel returns to wreak havoc and despair. Fates collide to forge a final conclusion for the panicked planet.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST
contents.title_native: 鋼の錬金術師 FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST
contents.intro: "‘Hagane no Renkinjutsushi: FULLMETAL ALCHEMIST’는 2009년 봄에 방영된 액션, 어드벤처, 드라마, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 bones입니다. 이야기의 중심에는 어떤 것을 얻기 위해서는 그에 상응하는 대가가 필요하다는 '동등 교환의 법칙'이 있으며, 이를 바탕으로 에드워드와 알폰스 엘릭 형제가 다양한 모험을 펼칩니다."

metadata.description:
"In order for something to be obtained, something of equal value must be lost."

Alchemy is bound by this Law of Equivalent Exchange—something the young brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric only realize after attempting human transmutation: the one forbidden act of alchemy. They pay a terrible price for their transgression—Edward loses his left leg, Alphonse his physical body. It is only by the desperate sacrifice of Edward's right arm that he is able to affix Alphonse's soul to a suit of armor. Devastated and alone, it is the hope that they would both eventually return to their original bodies that gives Edward the inspiration to obtain metal limbs called "automail" and become a state alchemist, the Fullmetal Alchemist.

Three years of searching later, the brothers seek the Philosopher's Stone, a mythical relic that allows an alchemist to overcome the Law of Equivalent Exchange. Even with military allies Colonel Roy Mustang, Lieutenant Riza Hawkeye, and Lieutenant Colonel Maes Hughes on their side, the brothers find themselves caught up in a nationwide conspiracy that leads them not only to the true nature of the elusive Philosopher's Stone, but their country's murky history as well. In between finding a serial killer and racing against time, Edward and Alphonse must ask themselves if what they are doing will make them human again... or take away their humanity.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

contents.title: Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!?
contents.intro: "Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!?는 J.C.STAFF가 제작한 2026년 겨울 방영 예정의 코미디와 로맨스 장르 애니메이션이다. 주인공인 고등학생 우타게 기노시타는 아이돌 타몬 후쿠하라를 위해 집안 일을 하며 헌신하는 생활을 하고 있다. 이야기는 우타게가 예상치 못한 상황에 처하게 되면서 시작된다."

metadata.description:
Utage Kinoshita is a high school girl who works part-time as a housekeeper. She has devoted her life to her favorite idol, Tamon Fukuhara, from the group F/ACE. Then one day, Utage ends up being assigned to Tamon’s house! There she discovers that off-stage, he is nothing like his wild idol persona. A gloomy, introverted boy with no self-confidence, Utage still finds herself falling for him anyway.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
contents.intro: "Jujutsu Kaisen(呪術廻戦)은 MAPPA가 제작한 2020년 가을 시즌의 액션, 드라마, 초자연적 장르 애니메이션으로, 사람들의 부정적인 감정들이 Cursed로 변해 나타나는 세계에서 소년이 '올바른 죽음'을 위해 싸우는 이야기이다. 이 작품은 84/100의 평점을 기록하고 있다."

metadata.description:
A boy fights... for "the right death."

Hardship, regret, shame: the negative feelings that humans feel become Curses that lurk in our everyday lives. The Curses run rampant throughout the world, capable of leading people to terrible misfortune and even death. What's more, the Curses can only be exorcised by another Curse.

Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a friend who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the Double-Faced Specter, taking the Curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with the Double-Faced Specter. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojou Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo Metropolitan Technical High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses... and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The first episode received an early web premiere on September 19th, 2020. The regular TV broadcast started on October 3rd, 2020.

contents.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 2nd Season
contents.intro: "Jujutsu Kaisen 2nd Season은 MAPPA가 제작한 2023년 여름 방영 애니메이션으로, 액션, 드라마, 초자연적 요소를 포함합니다. 이 시즌에서는 2학년 학생인 고죠 사토루와 게토 스구루가 어린 리코 아마나이를 마스터 텐겐에게 호위하는 이야기가 중심이 됩니다."

metadata.description:
The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen.

The past comes to light when second-year students Satoru Gojou and Suguru Getou are tasked with escorting young Riko Amanai to Master Tengen. But when a non-sorcerer user tries to kill them, their mission to protect the Star Plasma Vessel threatens to turn them into bitter enemies and cement their destinies—one as the world’s strongest sorcerer, and the other its most twisted curse user!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Medalist 2nd Season
contents.intro: 'Medalist 2nd Season'은 2026년 겨울에 방영되는 드라마, 심리, 스포츠 장르의 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 ENGI입니다. 이 시즌은 기존의 이야기를 이어가는 두 번째 시즌으로, 평점은 78/100입니다.

metadata.description: The second season of Medalist.

contents.title: HUNTER×HUNTER (2011)
contents.intro: HUNTER×HUNTER (2011)은 MADHOUSE가 제작한 액션, 어드벤처, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 토가시 요시히로의 동명 만화를 새롭게 각색한 작품입니다. 이 애니메이션은 다양한 위험한 임무를 수행하는 헌터들의 이야기를 다루고 있습니다. 평점은 89/100입니다.

metadata.description:
A new adaption of the manga of the same name by Togashi Yoshihiro.
A Hunter is one who travels the world doing all sorts of dangerous tasks. From capturing criminals to searching deep within uncharted lands for any lost treasures. Gon is a young boy whose father disappeared long ago, being a Hunter. He believes if he could also follow his father's path, he could one day reunite with him.
After becoming 12, Gon leaves his home and takes on the task of entering the Hunter exam, notorious for its low success rate and high probability of death to become an official Hunter. He befriends the revenge-driven Kurapika, the doctor-to-be Leorio and the rebellious ex-assassin Killua in the exam, with their friendship prevailing throughout the many trials and threats they come upon taking on the dangerous career of a Hunter.

contents.title: Akuyaku Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi ni Dekiai Sareru
contents.title_native: 悪役令嬢は隣国の王太子に溺愛される
contents.intro: 판타지와 로맨스를 다룬 애니메이션 "악역령주가 이웃국의 왕태자에게 몰두한다"는 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정이다. 제작사 Studio DEEN에서 제작하며, 주인공 티아라로즈는 자신의 전생을 기억하고 좋아하는 게임의 세계에 reincarnated되면서 이야기가 전개된다. 현재 평점은 60/100이다.

metadata.description:
Tiararose Lapis Clamentile is set to marry Hartknights, crown prince of Lapis Lazuli—until she suddenly remembers her past life and realizes she’s been reincarnated into her favorite game, The Ring of Lapis Lazuli, as the doomed villainess! But just as she’s about to lose hope, the crown prince of Aquasteed proposes instead. Could this unexpected turn finally lead to a happy ending of her own?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Prism Rondo
contents.intro: "프리즘 론도"는 WIT STUDIO에서 제작한 드라마와 로맨스를 기반으로 한 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영됩니다. "꽃보다 남자"로 잘 알려진 야코 카미오의 새로운 작품으로, 1900년대 초 런던의 미술 아카데미를 배경으로 한 이야기를 다룹니다. 평점은 84/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Yoko Kamio, whose manga "Boys Over Flowers" enraptured readers around the globe, brings a brand-new classic to viewers worldwide. Set at a London art academy in the opening decade of the 1900s, the Netflix Series "Love Through a Prism" follows Lili Ichijoin, a girl enchanted by painting, as she chases her dreams and experiences youth. This ensemble coming-of-age story about young people striving for prismatic radiance against the odds is about to begin.
(Source: Netflix)

contents.title: BLEACH
contents.intro: "BLEACH는 Studio Pierrot에서 제작한 액션, 어드벤처, 초자연 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2004년 가을에 방영되었습니다. 주인공 이치고 쿠로사키는 유령을 볼 수 있는 평범한 고등학생이며, 그의 특별한 능력은 신화적 존재인 신이가 등장하면서 전환점을 맞이합니다."

metadata.description:
Ichigo Kurosaki is a rather normal high school student apart from the fact he has the ability to see ghosts. This ability never impacted his life in a major way until the day he encounters the Shinigami Kuchiki Rukia, who saves him and his family's lives from a Hollow, a corrupt spirit that devours human souls. 

Wounded during the fight against the Hollow, Rukia chooses the only option available to defeat the monster and passes her Shinigami powers to Ichigo. Now forced to act as a substitute until Rukia recovers, Ichigo hunts down the Hollows that plague his town.

contents.title: Yuusha Party wo Oidasareta Kiyou Binbou
contents.title_native: 勇者パーティを追い出された器用貧乏
contents.intro: '야수파티를 쫓겨난 기용 빈부'는 액션, 어드벤처, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정이다. 제작사는 animation studio42이며, 주인공인 오르훈 두라는 childhood friend에게 배신당하고 영웅 파티에서 쫓겨난 후 고독한 여정을 시작한다. 이 작품은 65/100의 평점을 기록하고 있다.

metadata.description:
Betrayed by his childhood friend and cast out of the Hero Party, Orhun Dura—once their loyal Enchanter—is branded by his former comrades as “a jack-of-all-trades but a master of none.” Alone, he sets out to forge a new path as a solo adventurer. His journey sparks explosive battles, deadly rivals, and unexpected allies—and he’ll rise to shatter every expectation. The ultimate solo comeback begins!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki
contents.intro: 2026년 겨울 방영 예정인 'Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki'는 로맨스와 슬라이스 오브 라이프 장르의 애니메이션으로, East Fish Studio와 Atelier Peuplier에서 제작합니다. 주인공 요이 타키구치는 남성적인 외모를 가지고 있지만 사실은 여성으로, 그녀의 정체성과 일상적인 삶이 주된 줄거리를 이루고 있습니다. 현재 평점은 72/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Yoi Takiguchi has long legs, a deep voice, and a handsome face…in other words, Yoi is such a good-looking guy that most people don’t notice or care that she is, in fact, a girl. Indeed, she’s had the nickname “Prince” for as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai…the only person who really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she’s not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Sousou no Frieren
contents.intro: '소환사 프리렌'은 2023년 가을 시즌에 방송되는 어드벤처, 드라마, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 MADHOUSE입니다. 이 작품은 악마왕을 물리친 엘프 마법사 프리렌이 삶의 의미를 배우고 성장하는 과정을 그립니다. 현재 평점은 91/100으로, 깊이 있는 이야기와 캐릭터 발전이 주목받고 있습니다.

metadata.description:
The adventure is over but life goes on for an elf mage just beginning to learn what living is all about. Elf mage Frieren and her courageous fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her? Decades after their victory, the funeral of one her friends confronts Frieren with her own near immortality. Frieren sets out to fulfill the last wishes of her comrades and finds herself beginning a new adventure…

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: [Oshi no Ko] 3rd Season
contents.intro: 일본 애니메이션 [Oshi no Ko] 3rd Season은 드라마, 미스터리, 심리극, 초자연적 요소를 포함한 작품으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영됩니다. 제작사는 Doga Kobo이며, 이번 시즌은 "POP IN 2" 발매 후 6개월이 지난 시점을 배경으로 B-Komachi의 주요 활동을 다룹니다. 평점은 83/100입니다.

metadata.description:
The third season of [Oshi no Ko].

The story enters a new stage.

It's been six months since "POP IN 2" was released. Thanks to MEM-Cho's hard work, B-Komachi is about to get their major break. Aqua is a multi-talented entertainer, and Akane's career as a talented actress is going smoothly. Meanwhile, Kana lost the cheerfulness she once had. To track down the truth behind Ai and Goro's deaths, Ruby keeps rising in the entertainment world...

Using lies as a weapon.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Enen no Shouboutai: San no Shou Part 2
contents.title_native: 炎炎ノ消防隊 参ノ章 第2クール
contents.intro: 'Enen no Shouboutai: San no Shou Part 2'는 액션, 드라마, Sci-Fi, 초자연적 요소를 포함한 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영됩니다. 이 작품은 David Production에 의해 제작되었으며, 신라와 8구대가 세계의 종말을 막기 위해 마지막 불꽃에 맞서 싸우는 내용을 다룹니다. 평점은 79/100입니다.

metadata.description:
The second cour of Enen no Shouboutai: San no Shou. 

As chaos spreads, Shinra and Company 8 fight to stop a final, world-ending blaze. 

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

contents.title: Golden Kamuy: Saishuushou
contents.title_native: ゴールデンカムイ 最終章
contents.intro: '골든 카무이'의 마지막 시즌인 'Golden Kamuy: Saishuushou'는 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정입니다. 이 작품은 액션, 모험, 코미디 장르로, 제작사는 Brain's Base입니다. 현재 평점은 78점입니다.

metadata.description: The fifth and final season of Golden Kamuy.

contents.title: Hime-sama, "Goumon" no Jikan desu 2nd Season
contents.title_native: 姫様“拷問”の時間です 第2期
contents.intro: 겨울 2026에 방영 예정인 애니메이션 "Hime-sama, 'Goumon' no Jikan desu" 제2기는 코미디와 판타지 장르의 작품입니다. 전쟁 속에서 전설의 검 엑스칼리버를 지닌 공주가 캡쳐되어 감옥에 갇히고, 그녀가 직면하는 고문의 다양한 양상을 다룹니다. 제작사는 PINE JAM이며, 평점은 73/100입니다.

metadata.description:
As the war between the Imperial Army and Hellhorde rages on, the Princess, despite being armed with her mythical sword Excalibur, is captured and imprisoned. What kind of torture does she face at the hands of the chief demon interrogator? Fluffy fresh-baked toast! Hot, steaming ramen! Oh, the humanity! Can the Princess withstand these tormenting treats and keep her kingdom’s secrets safe?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Gachiakuta
contents.intro: 2025년 여름 방영 예정인 애니메이션 'Gachiakuta'는 액션, 드라마, 판타지 장르로, 제작사는 bones film입니다. 주인공은 부유한 자들과 가난한 자들이 공존하는 떠 있는 마을에서 살다가 살인범으로 잘못 기소되며 벌어지는 이야기를 다룹니다. 이 작품은 현재 82/100의 평점을 기록하고 있습니다.

metadata.description:
A boy lives in a floating town, where the poor scrape by and the rich live a sumptuous life, simply casting their garbage off the side, into the abyss. When he’s falsely accused of murder, though, his wrongful conviction leads to an unimaginable punishment—exile off the edge, with the rest of the trash. Down on the surface, the cast-off waste of humanity has bred vicious monsters, and to travel the path to vengeance against those who cast him into Hell, a boy will have to become a warrior…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

contents.title: Majutsushi Kunon wa Mieteiru
contents.title_native: 魔術師クノンは見えている
contents.intro: 2026년 겨울 방영 예정인 애니메이션 "Majutsushi Kunon wa Mieteiru"는 액션, 어드벤처, 판타지 장르로 Platinum Vision에서 제작하였습니다. 시각이 없는 젊은 남자 쿠논이 물 마법으로 새로운 눈을 만들기 위해 노력하며 성장하는 이야기를 담고 있습니다. 평점은 64/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Kunon, a young man who cannot see, has the goal of creating new eyes with water magic. After just five months of learning sorcery, Kunon surpassed his own mentor and honed his talent as he tried to do a feat that's never been done before. A fantasy about a young man, a blind genius, who opens up the world through curiosity in the pursuit for magic is about to begin.
(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru
contents.title_native: 貴族転生 ～恵まれた生まれから最強の力を得る～
contents.intro: 'Kizoku Tensei: Megumareta Umare kara Saikyou no Chikara wo Eru'는 겨울 2026 시즌에 방영될 액션, 모험, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션이다. 제작사 CompTown에서 제작하며, 주인공 Noah는 권력을 가진 제국의 13번째 자식으로 환생하여 무한 레벨 한계와 특별 능력을 가진다. 평점은 60/100으로 평가받고 있다.

metadata.description:
Noah, the world’s strongest six-year-old, has been privileged enough to be reborn as the emperor’s 13th child. What’s more, he’s been overpowered with an infinite level cap and a cheat that stacks the powers of anyone who serves him. But even privilege has its problems—the glittering facade of high society hides a world of conspiracies, schemes, and power struggles.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Ikoku Nikki
contents.intro: 일본 애니메이션 'Ikoku Nikki'는 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영되는 드라마와 슬라이스 오브 라이프 장르의 작품입니다. 제작사는 Shuka이며, 이야기는 고독한 소설가 마키오 코다이가 갑작스레 15세 조카 아사 타쿠의 보호자가 되는 과정을 중심으로 전개됩니다. 이 작품은 100점 만점에 83점을 기록했습니다.

metadata.description:
Reclusive novelist Makio Koudai has always preferred the company of books—but when her sister and brother-in-law pass away, Makio unexpectedly becomes the guardian of her 15-year-old niece, Asa Takumi. As they navigate grief, clashing personalities, and the challenges of living together, the two slowly open their hearts to each other, discovering warmth, understanding, and the meaning of family.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka.
contents.title_native: 綺麗にしてもらえますか。
contents.intro: 'Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka.'는 겨울 2026년 방영 예정의 코미디, 로맨스, 일상 장르 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 Okuruto Noboru입니다. 이 작품은 아타미의 해변 온천 마을에서 작은 세탁소를 운영하는 낙천적이고 성실한 주인공 킨메 와카나의 일상을 중심으로 전개됩니다.

metadata.description:
For the past two years, cheerful and hardworking Kinme Wakana has run a small laundry shop in the seaside hot springs town of Atami. As she goes about her quiet days, Wakana finds herself drawn into the bittersweet, heartwarming stories of the people around her.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
contents.title_native: 幼馴染とはラブコメにならない
contents.intro: Eeyuu는 고등학생으로, 두 명의 어린 시절 친구인 "시오"와 "아카리"를 좋아하게 되지만, 이들이 자신의 성적 관심을 알게 되면 안 된다는 고민에 빠진다. 이 애니메이션은 코미디와 로맨스를 결합한 작품으로, Tezuka Productions에서 제작하며, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영될 예정이다. 평점은 61/100이다.

metadata.description:
Eeyuu, a high school boy, has a problem! Two childhood friends "Shio" and "Akari" who go to the same high school are too cute! If they find out that I'm the only one looking sexually at them now that they've grown up, even though I have no intention of doing so... that would be too much! On the other hand, the two childhood friends also have their own secrets...? It's so awkward! It's complicated! But childhood friends are the best! A sweet and impatient love triangle love comedy where you can't be honest!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

contents.title: Fate/strange Fake
contents.intro: Fate/strange Fake는 A-1 Pictures에서 제작한 액션, 모험, 판타지, 미스터리, 초자연적 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울 시즌에 방영됩니다. 성배 전쟁을 배경으로 마법사와 그들의 영웅 영혼이 성배의 지배권을 위해 싸우는 이야기를 담고 있습니다. 본 작품은 82/100의 평점을 기록하고 있습니다.

metadata.description:
In a Holy Grail War, Mages (Masters) and their Heroic Spirits (Servants) fight for the control of the Holy Grail—an omnipotent wish-granting device said to fulfill any desire. Years have passed since the end of the Fifth Holy Grail War in Japan. Now, signs portend the emergence of a new Holy Grail in the western American city of Snowfield. Sure enough, Masters and Servants begin to gather... 

A missing Servant class...
Impossible Servant summonings...
A nation shrouded in secrecy...
And a city created as a battleground.

In the face of such irregularities, the Holy Grail War is twisted and driven into the depth of madness. Let the curtain rise on a masquerade of humans and heroes, made to dance upon the stage of a false Holy Grail. This is a Holy Grail War covered in lies.

(Source: Official Site, Aniplex USA, edited)

Notes:
•  Special premiere of Episode 1 in its English Dub occurred in Los Angeles at the Fate 20th Anniversary Showcase event and as well through Crunchyroll’s YouTube Channel on November 23, 2024 before the Japanese television premiere.
•  The Japanese advanced premiere occurred during the "Fate New Year's Eve TV Special 2024" on December 31, 2024.

contents.title: ONE PIECE
contents.intro: "애니메이션 '원피스'는 액션, 어드벤처, 코미디, 드라마, 판타지 장르로 1999년 가을에 방영되었으며, Toei Animation에서 제작했습니다. 이야기는 해적왕 골드 로저의 체포 및 사망 후, 그의 유산을 찾아 나서는 젊은 해적 몽키 D. 루피와 그의 동료들의 모험을 중심으로 전개됩니다. 평점은 88/100입니다."

metadata.description:
Gold Roger was known as the Pirate King, the strongest and most infamous being to have sailed the Grand Line. The capture and death of Roger by the World Government brought a change throughout the world. His last words before his death revealed the location of the greatest treasure in the world, One Piece. It was this revelation that brought about the Grand Age of Pirates, men who dreamed of finding One Piece (which promises an unlimited amount of riches and fame), and quite possibly the most coveted of titles for the person who found it, the title of the Pirate King.
Enter Monkey D. Luffy, a 17-year-old boy that defies your standard definition of a pirate. Rather than the popular persona of a wicked, hardened, toothless pirate who ransacks villages for fun, Luffy’s reason for being a pirate is one of pure wonder; the thought of an exciting adventure and meeting new and intriguing people, along with finding One Piece, are his reasons of becoming a pirate. Following in the footsteps of his childhood hero, Luffy and his crew travel across the Grand Line, experiencing crazy adventures, unveiling dark mysteries and battling strong enemies, all in order to reach One Piece.
*This includes following special episodes:
- Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore! (Episode 336)
- The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle! (Episode 492)
- Team Formation! Save Chopper (Episode 542)
- History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (Episode 590)
- 20th Anniversary! Special Romance Dawn (Episode 907)

contents.title: Yuusha Kei ni Shosu: Choubatsu Yuusha 9004-tai Keimu Kiroku
contents.title_native: 勇者刑に処す　懲罰勇者9004隊刑務記録
contents.intro: 'Yuusha Kei ni Shosu: Choubatsu Yuusha 9004-tai Keimu Kiroku'는 스튜디오 KAI에서 제작한 액션, 코미디, 드라마, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영됩니다. 이 작품은 영웅주의가 처벌받는 세계에서, 신을 처형당한 Xylo Forbartz가 Penal Hero Unit 9004의 일원으로 끊임없이 괴물과 싸우는 이야기를 다룹니다. 에피소드마다 죽음이 아닌 또 다른 싸움의 연속을 보여줍니다.

metadata.description:
In a world where heroism is a punishment, Xylo Forbartz, a condemned goddess killer, battles endless hordes of monstrous abominations as part of Penal Hero Unit 9004. Death is no escape, only a cycle of resurrection and relentless combat. But when Xylo encounters a mysterious new goddess, their unlikely alliance sparks a rebellion that could shatter the chains of eternal punishment.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Notes:
- The first episode aired with a runtime of ~58 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.
- Initially scheduled to air in October, 2025

contents.title: Seihantai na Kimi to Boku
contents.intro: '정반대의 너와 나'는 2026년 겨울 방영 예정인 코미디, 드라마, 로맨스, 슬라이스 오브 라이프 장르의 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 래핀 트랙입니다. 주인공 스즈키는 사랑에 빠진 고등학생으로, 조용하고 내성적인 동급생 타니 유스케와의 대비되는 성격을 통해 이야기가 전개됩니다. 평점은 80/100입니다.

metadata.description:
Suzuki’s a high school girl in love, but the guy she’s fallen for is nothing like her! While she’s cheerful, outgoing, and always trying to fit in, her classmate Yusuke Tani is stoic, quiet, and doesn’t seem to care what people think of him. Will Suzuki be able to overcome her anxieties and ask him out, or will she discover that opposites really don’t attract?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Jujutsu Kaisen: Shimetsu Kaiyuu - Zenpen
contents.title_native: 呪術廻戦 死滅回游 前編
contents.intro: 'Jujutsu Kaisen: Shimetsu Kaiyuu - Zenpen'은 2026년 겨울에 방영되는 애니메이션으로, MAPPA가 제작한 액션, 드라마, 판타지 장르의 작품입니다. 이 시리즈는 '신부야 사건' 이후 노리토시 카모가 주관하는 치명적인 주술 전투인 '사멸 회유'가 일본의 열 개의 식민지에서 벌어지는 이야기를 다룹니다. 평점은 84/100입니다.

metadata.description:
The third season of Jujutsu Kaisen.
After the Shibuya Incident, a deadly jujutsu battle known as the Culling Game orchestrated by Noritoshi Kamo erupts across ten colonies in Japan.
Haunted by guilt over the mass killings in Shibuya and wary of Sukuna’s interest in Fushiguro, Itadori chooses not to return to Jujutsu High. Instead, he teams up with Choso to exorcise the countless cursed spirits unleashed by Noritoshi Kamo.
Amid this chaos, the Jujutsu Headquarters revokes Yuji Itadori’s suspended death sentence and appoints special-grade sorcerer Yuta Okkotsu as his executioner. 
Newly awakened modern sorcerers and resurrected ancient ones,  now fighting as players in the Culling Game, collide with conflicting motives, driving the world once more toward an age ruled by jujutsu.
(Source: TOHO Animation)

contents.title: Sousou no Frieren 2nd Season
contents.title_native: 葬送のフリーレン 第2期
contents.intro: 'Sousou no Frieren'의 두 번째 시즌이 2026년 겨울에 방영됩니다. 이 작품은 어드벤처, 드라마, 판타지 장르로, MADHOUSE에서 제작하였으며 현재 평점은 89/100입니다. 세월이 흐른 후의 모험과 감정을 다룬 이야기를 이어갈 예정입니다.

metadata.description: The second season of Sousou no Frieren.

contents.title: Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia ILLEGALS 2nd Season
contents.title_native: ヴィジランテ -僕のヒーローアカデミア ILLEGALS- 第2期
contents.intro: 'Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia ILLEGALS 2nd Season'은 2026년 겨울에 방영되는 액션, 어드벤처, 드라마, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션입니다. 이 작품은 bones film에서 제작하였으며, Vigilante 시리즈의 두 번째 시즌으로 진행됩니다. 평점은 72/100으로 평가받고 있습니다.

metadata.description: The second season of Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia ILLEGALS.

contents.title: Jigokuraku 2nd Season
contents.intro: 2026년 겨울, 인기 애니메이션 '지옥락'의 두 번째 시즌이 방영된다. 이 시리즈는 액션, 모험, 미스터리, 초자연적 요소로 구성되어 있으며, MAPPA에서 제작한다. 현재 평점은 80/100으로 평가받고 있다.

metadata.description: The second season of Jigokuraku.

contents.title: [Oshi no Ko] 2nd Season
contents.intro: 2024년 여름, Doga Kobo가 제작한 일본 애니메이션 [Oshi no Ko]의 두 번째 시즌이 방영된다. 이 시즌에서는 Aqua의 복수 욕망이 중심 이야기로 펼쳐지며, 그의 쌍둥이 여동생 Ruby와 함께 어두운 엔터테인먼트 세계를 탐험하는 과정을 다룬다. 해당 작품은 드라마, 미스터리, 심리, 초자연적인 요소로 구성되어 있으며, 평점은 85/100이다.

metadata.description:
The second season of [Oshi no Ko].

Aqua’s desire for revenge takes center stage as he navigates the dark underbelly of the entertainment world alongside his twin sister, Ruby. While Ruby follows in their slain mother’s footsteps to become an idol, Aqua joins a famous theater troupe in hopes of uncovering clues to the identity of his father — the man who arranged their mother’s untimely death, and the man who once starred in the same troupe Aqua hopes to infiltrate.

(Source: HIDIVE)

contents.title: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season
contents.title_native: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 3rd season
contents.intro: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season은 WHITE FOX가 제작한 액션, 모험, 드라마, 판타지, 심리, 로맨스, 스릴러 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2024년 가을에 방영됩니다. 서브가의 성전환 이후 1년이 지난 시점에서 에밀리아와 그녀의 동료들이 모여 새로운 이야기를 펼치는 내용을 담고 있습니다. 평점은 84/100입니다.

metadata.description:
The third season of Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu. 

A year has passed since Subaru’s victory at the Sanctuary. He savors a life of fulfillment while Emilia’s camp stands united for the royal selection—until a fateful letter arrives. Anastasia, a royal selection candidate, has invited Emilia to the Watergate City of Priestella. But as the party begins its journey, crisis stirs beneath the surface and Subaru meets a cruel fate once again.
(Source: Crunchyroll) 

Notes:
The first episode has an extended runtime of ~90 minutes, and received an early premiere at Anime Expo on July 5, 2024.

contents.title: Chou Kaguya-hime!
contents.intro: 애니메이션 "Chou Kaguya-hime!"는 일본의 고전 설화를 재구성한 작품으로, 액션, 코미디, 드라마, 판타지, 음악, 공상과학 장르가 혼합되어 있습니다. 2026년 겨울에 공개될 이 작품은 Studio Colorido와 Studio Chromato에서 제작하였으며, 평점은 85/100입니다. 이 이야기는 이세계의 아름다움과 천상의 비밀을 탐구합니다.

metadata.description:
A tale of otherworldly beauty and celestial secrets unfolds in this new take on Japan’s oldest folktale.

Inspired by The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter, the film reimagines Japan’s oldest folktale with a modern touch by integrating music, fantasy, and contemporary animation.

Set in the virtual realm of Tsukuyomi, the story unfolds as a live performance marrying original music with Yamashita’s signature style of polished visuals, emotive pacing, and dynamic 3D camerawork to boldly transform this classic tale for a new generation.

(Source: Netflix, edited)

contents.title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto
contents.intro: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto(약屋의 독백)는 OLM과 TOHO animation STUDIO가 제작한 드라마 및 미스터리 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2023년 가을 방영 예정이다. 주인공 마오마오는 약국 아버지와 평화로운 삶을 살다가 황궁의 하인으로 팔려가며 시작되는 이야기를 다룬다. 평점은 88/100으로, 궁중에서의 복잡한 상황 속에서 그녀의 비범한 성격이 드러나는 과정을 그린다.

metadata.description:
Maomao lived a peaceful life with her apothecary father. Until one day, she’s sold as a lowly servant to the emperor’s palace. But she wasn’t meant for a compliant life among royalty. So when imperial heirs fall ill, she decides to step in and find a cure! This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she’s making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Hell Mode: Yarikomi Suki no Gamer wa Haisettei no Isekai de Musou Suru
contents.title_native: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～
contents.intro: 2026년 겨울에 방영되는 애니메이션 '헤ルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～'는 액션, 어드벤처, 판타지 장르로, Yokohama Animation Lab에서 제작한 작품입니다. 주인공 켄이치 야마다가 MMORPG의 세계에서 새로운 도전을 하며 겪는 이야기를 담고 있습니다. 평점은 65점이며, 깊이 있는 게임 경험을 추구하는 캐릭터의 모험을 그립니다.

metadata.description:
Thirty-five-year-old Kenichi Yamada has spent his life playing every single MMORPG he can get his hands on. Tired of new games that cater to casual players, he leaps at the chance to try out a never-ending game with an intimidating “Hell Mode” that raises the difficulty (and chances to level up) to impossible heights. But, as soon as he selects the “Summoner,” Kenichi finds himself transported into the world of the game and reborn to a family of serfs as a baby named Allen! With nothing but his memories and wits to guide him, Allen sets off to conquer Hell Mode, unearth the secrets of the Summoner class, and free his newfound family from their fate.

(Source: HIDIVE)

contents.title: Hanazakari no Kimitachi e
contents.intro: "Hanazakari no Kimitachi e는 Signal.MD에서 제작한 2026년 겨울 방영 예정의 코미디, 드라마, 로맨스, 슬라이스 오브 라이프 장르 애니메이션이다. 주인공 미즈키 아시야는 자신의 우상이자 하이점프 스타인 이즈미 사노를 만나기 위해 소년으로 변장해 남자 기숙사 학교에 입학하는 이야기다."

metadata.description:
Mizuki Ashiya is on a mission: disguise herself as a boy and enroll in a male boarding school to meet her idol, high jump star Izumi Sano. But after successfully infiltrating the school, she discovers he’s suddenly quit the sport! Now Mizuki must dodge suspicion, protect her cover, and somehow reach the boy she came all this way for—all while surviving the chaos of an all-boys dorm!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Boku no Hero Academia FINAL SEASON
contents.title_native: 僕のヒーローアカデミア FINAL SEASON
contents.intro: 'Boku no Hero Academia FINAL SEASON'은 액션과 모험 장르의 애니메이션으로, 제작사는 bones film입니다. 이 시리즈의 최종 시즌인 이번 편에서는 데쿠와 영웅들이 일본 전역의 악당들과 최종 전투를 벌입니다. 평점은 87/100으로 평가받고 있습니다.

metadata.description:
The eighth and final season of Boku no Hero Academia.

Deku and the heroes are plunged into a final battle against villains across Japan. Deku, by fully unleashing One For All Quirks, faces off against Shigaraki. A young and refreshed All For One faces Armored All Might, Quirkless in his powered armor suit. Will Deku be able to bring the story of how they all became the greatest heroes to its finale? Or will everything be destroyed?!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

contents.title: Tensei Shitara Dragon no Tamago Datta
contents.title_native: 転生したらドラゴンの卵だった
contents.intro: '전생한 드래곤의 알'은 액션, 어드벤처, 판타지 장르의 애니메이션으로, 2026년 겨울에 방영될 예정이다. GA-CREW와 Felix Film이 제작한 이 작품은, 주인공이 드래곤 알 안에서 재탄생하며 겪는 모험을 다룬다. 평점은 62/100이다.

metadata.description:
Our hero needs to come out of his shell... literally! Reborn in another world inside a dragon egg, he doesn’t have the amazing magic or mighty physical strength of your typical isekai’d adventurer just yet. He’ll need to break free and grow from a weak hatchling and into a fearsome beast if he wants to escape the deep, dark forest unscathed. What battles and adventures await him in this unique take on the isekai phenomenon?

(Source: HIDIVE)
